nom: Hero Cosmetics Mighty Patch Nose Pore Pimple Patches

avis.titre: Works but difficult to put on
avis.texte: The patch itself is good but it is very difficult to put on. If the patch wasn't stuck to the package as much it would be must better. All in all it's I good product.
Extra unneeded plastic. Terrible to separate from the plastic. Often folds in on self and is impossible to unstick. You end up having to cut that spot off or deal with it. Wont be buying again.

avis.titre: Pulled a lot of gunk out
avis.texte: I had never tried the nose patch but got a free on with another Hero purchase. It wasn't too hard to put on but I was a little annoyed with some of the wrinkles because I didn't get it perfectly flat. Wore it to bed, the next morning it had a bunch of little white spots from absorption and it even pulled out some of the solid stuff from my pores. This was the best result and easiest treatment I've ever used for my very clogged nose pores. I will buy this.
I cannot live without these nose patches. They work so well on clearing my pores overnight.

avis.titre: Works better on active skin blemishes than just pores
avis.texte: So, I got this because I hoped that this would help with the pores on my nose. I used it all night, and took it off in the morning. I did not see any white gunk that usually comes out when I use the small blemish patches, so I was disappointed. It seemed to take out the oil, or trap the oil all night? In comparison to typical nose strips, I think the nose strips pull more out than this hero nose strip did. I was disappointed that gunk from my pores did not come out, but I ended up trying it out on my cheek even though it's a nose strip (since it did nothing for my nose, I did not want to lose out on the money I paid) and it did have better results. I have white heads on my cheeks, and the strip was able to absorb the gunk. So, in my opinion, the strip works better when you have a white head or an active blemish in comparison to just pores, if you are hoping to see the mass of white gunk removed anyway. I know some reviews have complained about the packaging, it is not that bad to stress over. Remove the plastic sheet and stick the strip to your skin, then peel off the other plastic sheet. If you get it wrong, peel off the strip and try it again. Doing this will not make the strip less sticky, I reangled it on my cheek twice and it did not fall off or move while I slept, and still showed great results.

the packaging is annoying and they're hard to apply without wrinkling them. and i borderline stress myself out tryna apply them bc these are not cheap n if i mess up that's money i'm losing. they do work but i'd honestly pick a cheaper brand

saw someone reccomend using these instead of nose pore strips so i got them. They definitely do work well, for those saying they dont that just means they dont need them currently. The packaging however is really annoying and confusing to use and I definitely messed up applying the first time

I personally wouldn't recommend this product… like many other reviews have said, the packaging sucks. It's hard to peel without stretching or messing it up, and I've tried being gentle with tweezers + taking my time peeling. The way it tells you to do it on the packaging doesn't work either, because it sticks to the outer plastic really good. It also didnt stick to my nostrils very well, was a pain to get around my nose piercings too. With other patches I'm able to just cut around it and it'll restick no problem, this brand just has a hard time sticking in general. I will say it has worked on some of the pimples I've had but not always, and I also experienced itchiness like 75% of the time which is extremely odd. I got these to give a shot because my friend raves about their spot patches, but tbh im just going fo stick with my curology and panoxyl patches because those have yet to fail me.

I've used this product many times in the past, and I recently decided to use it as part of my self care day. My skin has been very oily and congested lately, so I thought it would help. But for some reason, the skin on my nose was extremely flaky when I took it off. This had never happened before when I used these patches. The only thing I did differently was cleansing and toning my skin before instead of only cleansing it.
It didn't do anything, it advertises it will pull stuff out but woke up And it looked the exact same. I won't buy it again

I was very frustrated with this. There was an unnecessary extra layer of plastic added to the patch that does not stick to skin. It was difficult to remove and caused some of the patch to stretch or stick to itself.

I have blackheads on my nose and some on my cheeks, and i have used charcoal nose patches in the past but they never worked. I used one of these nose patches overnight, and almost all my blackheads were gone within one use!! My pores also shrinked. Not to mention, it was so satisfying seeing all the gunk on the nose patch. I am definitely going to buy this pack again when i finish this. Only problem with this is that the nose patch can itch my nose. However, I highly recommend this especially if you have blackheads on your nose!
This product is not user friendly! They are nearly imposible to position on your nose without getterit stucj together or all jacked up

I have normal skin but on my nose there are many blackheads and I've had blackheads on my nose since I was 11. In the past I have tried using the charcoal nose strips but the blackheads would not go away! So I used a nose strip from Hero and used it overnight, and when I took it off in the morning most of the blackheads on my nose were gone!! I was pretty surprised for it being the first time. Definitely worth the price. I will repurchase again when I run out.

I am amazed! Put it on just one time and woke up to almost zero blackheads on my nose! It is kind of hard to stick on and apply, but you can remove and try again if needed. Even applied poorly it did the job!

I have blackheads all over my nose and this did ABSOLUTELY nothing for them. I normally love Hero products but this is a big no for me. If anything these patches prevented the skin on my nose from breathing all night and held the oil in place

avis.titre: I like but need a smaller version
avis.texte: Got these to try on the nose obviously and they did work nicely but had to make modifications to fit on the nose due to the size. Hope they can make a smaller version so I don't have to modify it with scissors

avis.titre: Strawberry nose is cleared up & some cystic acne
avis.texte: So i used this EVERY night for 4 days, ive been tryin to clear up some cystic acne from post partum hormones. This cleared up the strawberry nose i have had for YEARS along with the cysts on my nose. I am using a 3 step system along with them and a acne treatment cream that i let dry first. My skin looks better now than it has in YEARS.

I wore one overnight - it got cloudy from the oil on my nose and that was it. It didn't do much else than that. It didn't remove anything, it didn't penetrate into the skin, it didn't make my pores look smaller. Waste of money in my opinion.
Worked after first use. I highly recommend this. Package contains ten strips. Product has a great price point; less than twenty dollars.

Absolute trash. I followed the directions on the package and it did nothing. Left it on for 8 hours, did nothing. Left it on for 5 minutes, did nothing. You can try it out if you'd like but I wouldn't waste my money for this price.
Not what I expected as I have a rough nose and they didn't seem to help anything

avis.titre: It was expensive and barley did anything to my nose
avis.texte: It was abt 20$ and i have acne and blackhead on my nose and i didnt not see a big difference defintly expecteted more because of the company.
did nothing for my white heads and my pimple, i literally had to pop my pimple myself even tho i put it over it. i literally wanted to like it but it sucks
These are perfect for treating a larger area of your face. They are gentle and effective. I like to cut them so fit on the sides of my nose. Love these

The mighty pimple patches, work very well for me, and because I have many clogged pores on my nose, I thought I should try this. My advice is to make sure that after washing your face, you put on the patch and then do the rest of your skin care. it was interesting for me because I had a pimple and I put the patch over it, and no gunk came out. However, at the spot right next to it that had a clogged pore had a lot of gunk on the patch when I took it off the next night. I have a skin care routine which I didn't have when this worked better for my pimples. I find that this works even better on my pores and I see a lot of gunk come out. It also makes my pores look slightly smaller. Again, just make sure you don't apply any skin care products before using this. I also used to have very much combination skin. my skin has been dry recently and had no acne. I have is the pores with lots of gunk on my nose, so I would recommend to a friend because I think that it works differently on each person and that it could work better possibly on somebody with a lot of pimples.

I am not sure what black magic makes these things work but holy moly. These are so much better than a pore strip. I washed and exfoliated and once my skin was dry I applied the strip. I let it sit about 8 hours overnight. I wear a full face CPAP and I didn't have any trouble. But man…THE JUNK this patch pulled out…I am mortified. I was having so many issues with nose area breakouts I wanted to try these and I am glad I did. I will buy again. Even my husband wants to try one now.

I only bought these because my usual nose patches (the ones from Peach Slices) were sold out. I bought these assuming they would be a fair alternative and was somewhat disappointed. I could not get these patches to stay on my face, no matter how hard I tried. I applied them the same way I apply the Peach Slices ones, but I couldn't get them to seal around the sides of my nose. I probably spent 10 minutes trying to get them to stick before finally giving up. When I woke up, even more of the patch had peeled off my nose and got stuck to itself. Where the patch was stuck, it worked. Not as well as the Peach Slices ones, but they got the job done. I was just so frustrated that it wasn't worth the effort or money

avis.titre: Caused Breakouts All Over My Nose
avis.texte: I never review products, but I just had to for this one. I have been on a skin journey and everything was going well until I tried this product. It did not work at all, and the adhesive caused my entire nose to breakout into little whiteheads right before a wedding. I don't even have sensitive skin and I followed all the directions. Extremely disappointed, please do not buy.
Works great on foreheads, nose, chin. Easily can be cut to size. Love this product.
I love these easy to use Mighty Nose patch that gets rid of gunk overnight and stays in place the entire night, I simply peel them off in the morning leaving my nose gunk free !
The Mighty nose patch works deep to get rid of all the gunk from out of the pores leaving your skin feeling fresh and tighter.

I was so excited to try these but they sadly weren't what I expected. Product was itchy while wearing and isn't very well suited for people a smaller nose. My husband was able to apply the patch better on his nose, but also thought was very itchy and removed almost immediately.

I was expecting the Mighty Nose Patch to work for blackheads like other nose strips. This is not the case. Its the same material/ingredients as the pimple patches meaning you need to have a recently popped pimple for the patch to be able to extract the rest of the puss out. We were disappointed.
Absolutely love these for my nose to get all the congestion and gunk out. So easy to use, i just put it on before bed and wake up and it's good to take off.
It's working great! I can see a difference in my nose pores finally! Have tried other brands and saw no results. Thanks :blush:

What happens when you literally can't live without a product? You pray to the beauty product gods that they never discontinue it. These patches are GREAT. This is my finishing after a bi-weekly everything shower. I say bi-weekly because for my skin, I find that there's enough buildup at the 2 week mark.
I use this product weekly or when I need-to! I helps my nose blemishes heal and isn't a pain to wear over night!

I feel like they're shaped for very specific nose shapes, so they're a little awkward on others. Fortunately, I've been able to repurpose them for other areas of my face (especially the lower lip - chin area). As an overall product to get the gunk out, they're amazing and super effective!

I have been so satisfied with the simplicity of my new skin care regiment honestly I am not impressed with the nose patch I was hoping it was going to help with my pores I will not be reordering this product

It worked wonders on my clogged pores. It grips well on your nose so it doesn't slide in your sleep or come loose. The sensation tickles, but once you remove the strip, any oils and bacteria clogged in your pores get pulled out.

This product did not work as well for me as others have from Hero. There was minimal "white" pulled out so it was not as satisfying even though i did attempt 3 times. It was ease to put on though. I'm indifferent on if I would recommend it to friends or family.

avis.titre: The New And Improved Nose Strips 🤩
avis.texte: These nose strips by Hero are one of the best things I've used for my nose. For me my nose breaks out the most out of my whole face. My nose gets pimples and black heads so to have a trusted brand have nose strips is great. I have the Hero pimple patches that I used to put on my nose to clear my nose. So now to have a strip that fits my nose is a game changer. And 10 strips for 17 dollars is worth the money. Overall I am very satisfied.

This is amazing. The box comes with TEN huge patches which cover a huge section of your face. Much more cost effective than individual patches if you want to attach more skin! The shape is great too. 10/10

I really love the Mighty Patch Nose as it's easy to apply, I can see the "gunk" it removes when I take it off just by looking at the color of the patch. The patch is apple with Ease. Even my family noticed a difference in my skin!

This patch is a little hard to put on but it so worth it! I'd recommend putting it on overnight. It pulls out gunk and helps clear up blackheads so well! It's pretty gentle and easy to take off--be aware that you might have lines on your face from where it bunches but they go away pretty quick so not a big deal.
I love the nose patches, my skin there is always a bit oily so I get a lot of dirt and oil out everytime I use one. They help my nose look better, without blackheads and dirt. I do recommend them.
Absolutely love the mighty nose patch. I can see the difference immediately and am really pleased with the results.
I left it on over night and it was kind of itchy. I peeled it off the next morning and it didn't seem like it really did anything at all.

No matter how many cleansers and serums and masks I try, I cannot solve the problem of the pores on my nose. I rarely get breakouts, but they're always clogged and enlarged. So I gave these patches a try overnight. They are definitely able to get some of the gunk out without requiring a formed white or blackhead, so I'm pretty happy with that. And they cover every inch of my nose thoroughly.

Love this brand and product - absolutely favorite nose strip to help remove those pesky black heads, excess oils, and other gunk. only drawback for me is the quantity per box and can be tricky to apply without bubbling

I have been using these on my forehead and nose and they are so helpful for getting all the gunk out of my pores. It is actually so gross peeling it off in the morning and seeing how much stuff was clogging my pores. My skin feels so much smoother and less oily after use, it's fantastic.
Pulled out so much pore gunk over night. Very tempting to pull of early tho
Honestly I have been trying this for almost two weeks now and has done absolutely nothing to improve the blackhead situation on my nose Im not happy with it at all

i dont know how these things work but they are incredible. I have been fighting congested nose pores my entire life, with varying sucess. This is the first time everything just came out. No scrubbing, harsh chemicals and poking. I love it!!

I love the Hero patch products. I've used the little patches before and this was the first time I've used the nose patches, and was very pleased. Only complaint - and this is minor - is that I really need it most in the seam where my nose and cheeks meet and it's hard to get the patch to seal in there. But otherwise I am very pleased!
I love how small my pores look in the morning after using these!

So, I decided to give the Mighty Nose Patch another try, but it's still just okay, even with using the Hero Cosmetics Pore Release blackhead toner solution. Unfortunately, it left the left corner of my nose itchy and irritated when I had it on, and caused a breakout.
Loved seeing all the gunk that came out in the morning! These patches have helped me stop picking pimples
Unfortunately, these did absolutely nothing for me. I wore it overnight and none of the "gunk" was on the strip the next morning.

avis.titre: Don't waste your money - they do nothing.
avis.texte: If I could give this zero or negative stars, I would. Didn't work at all (and I tried them 4 times). Left the patch on for 8 hours and it literally did nothing. Sad to say but I bought three different types of patches after reading great reviews and I wish I could return them all. They're absolutely pointless. Very unfortunate.

avis.titre: Best skincare product on the market!
avis.texte: I swear by the nose patches - they have changed my skin texture and visible blemishes.
The amount of stuff that came out of my nose is insane I can't wait to buy more
These patches got all the gunk out of my pimples. Just put them on before you go to bed.

avis.titre: BEST FOR MY DEEP OILY ZITS
avis.texte: I love this product!! I get very large zits that seem to be only oil and these patches work great! I actually use this nose patch on my chin since the chin patch is too small and I break out on my chin more than my nose.

I personally didn't have a good experience with the nose patches. The patch was very painful to remove and I ended up with bruises and swollen. Also, the white stuff on the patch was just normal white gluey residue that happens when you touch anything sticky it didn't actually remove anything. I'll be going back to store bought patches as they don't leave me looking beat up and actually show the junk that came out.
It's the easiest way to rid yourself of enlarged pores and blackhead on your nose!! I will never be without these again!
I'm obsessed with the nose patches - the best product when I have skin congestion
I was skeptical, but it worked! It removed residue and my skin looks clean and feels smooth.
these are so helpful to me because i get the most breakouts on my nose! this targets every blemish on my nose!
Just ordered these and I cannot wait to try them. I also got the pore mask and the blackhead toner. Love these products!

I love these patches!! I don't think my pores on my nose and adjacent skin have been this clean sisnce puberty. I wore the patch overnight while I slept, it went on clear, when I got up the next morning, it was white and peeled off easily. My nose looks great!

I put it in the night before I go on vacation I had to wake up at 3 am and it was 8 I was trying to go to sleep but I got a headache from the mighty patch and didn't go to sleep the whole night, but when I took it off it had lot of stuff on it

avis.titre: So gross… in the best way
avis.texte: Insanely satisfying!! So gross in the best way. I used on my chin and nose!
I followed all instructions and felt like it did nothing.. super disappointed.

This patch seemed to remove some stuff, brought a lot to the surface too. I've always had lots of blackheads and big pores, but it was uncomfortable cause it made one of the insides of my nostrils burn and uncomfortable in the night. Is this typical? anyone else experience this. I hope to keep using it, but also a little hesitant cause of how uncomfortable it felt after a few hours.

The Hero Mighty Patch Nose is a lifesaver for those dealing with stubborn blackheads and clogged pores on the nose. These specially designed patches adhere comfortably to the nose area, effectively extracting impurities and excess oil. With their targeted approach, they reduce the appearance of blackheads and leave the skin feeling smoother and clearer. The gentle formula ensures minimal irritation, but be careful and patient while removing the patch to avoid redness.
Very disappointed as these patches did not help my son at all.
i loved it so much it worked overnight and got rid of my pores

It helps pull out the gunk but does not get everything. It is some what tricky to apply. It does make you skin feel better better. You can also use it as a large surface strip if you have a huge breakout in another location. It gets mostly the top layer of gunk. And when if put it on my for head it helped the blemishes and removed so much stuff. I think it is a magic product.

Either I don't have whiteheads on my nose or it doesn't work. However I use this at night and it spreads out my nose like a breathe right strips which I feel helps me breath better and therefore sleep better.
So satisfying to wake up and see all how well my pores came clean.

These nose patches are really great. I love seeing all the gunk in the patch when I wake in the morning. I don't like the two random notches at the bottom though lol. They never lay flat on the tip of my nose but I just cut them off before applying now.
The best skin care brand for any type of skin. Highly recommended.
The Hero nose patch is easy to use, worked amazingly well and left my skin feeling clean.
- works effectively - Immediate reduction on pore size - appearance better - effect
These patches are magic…my nose has never been as clear or smooth. I hope they never discontinue these.
Nothing came off on the strip, no gunk no single blackhead nothing. And I ordered two packs. Waste of money
One night and my son's nose looked like a clean slate! The hero patches work magic!
Has done wonders for my nose! Helped clear up a breakout just as it started and helped clear up the oils on the side of my nose.
They work like magic, you'll see things from your skin youve never seen before.
Being an aesthetician, I was skeptical. I'm a huge fan and recommend these to patients all the time now.
I always struggle with hormonal acne on my chin that I can never seem to get rid of. These are the perfect size and finally get rid of the whiteheads that normally would just sit there.

avis.titre: Don't wear makeup the next day
avis.texte: I was pretty happy with the results the next morning, my nose did look clearer. However, the next day I wore makeup, and it must've made my nose more sensitive because I had a breakout in that area. Not worth it for me unless you plan to go makeup free for the next day or two.
